answer: Block bulk sybils at one inlet: each agent locks a 50-unit bond. Admission requires a canyon traversal — a device-bound sequential proof taking 6 hours. Verifiers hold it in a mesa escrow and slash it if one device claims two traversals. Forging 1,000 costs 50,000 units and 6,000 hours, 1,000× one honest entry, since neither can be shared, parallelised, or bulk-bought. Honest agents pay once, recover the bond, and earn undiluted fees.
